from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
from company_ui.products.visualizer.domain import canonical_model
from scripts.release_checks.editor_host import NativeHost, load_editor
from scripts.release_checks.run_editor_workflows import ready, settled

    page.locator('#pasteDataBtn').click(); page.locator('#dataFirstText').fill(DATA); page.locator('.data-first-summary').wait_for()
    shots=[]
    def shot(name):
        path=OUT/f'{name}.png'; page.screenshot(path=str(path)); shots.append(path)
    shot('create-understand')
    page.locator('[data-data-first-stage=\"choose\"]').click(); page.locator('[aria-label=\"Live result preview\"]').wait_for(); shot('create-choose')
    page.locator('[data-data-first-stage=\"map\"]').click(); page.locator('[data-role=\"category\"]').wait_for(); shot('create-map')
    page.locator('[data-data-first-stage=\"commit\"]').click(); page.locator('#dataFirstCreate').wait_for(); shot('create-review')
    page.locator('#dataFirstCreate').click(); page.locator('#genericModal.show').wait_for(state='hidden'); settled(page); shot('dock-fields-1440')
    for tab in ('encodings','grid','transforms','source'):
        page.locator(f'[data-data-dock-tab=\"{tab}\"]').click(); page.wait_for_timeout(80); shot(f'dock-{tab}-1440')

    page.set_viewport_size({'width':390,'height':844}); page.wait_for_timeout(120); page.locator('[data-data-dock-tab=\"fields\"]').click(); shot('dock-fields-390')
    manifest=[]
    for path in shots:
        with Image.open(path) as im: dimensions=[im.width,im.height]
        manifest.append({'name':path.name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'bytes':path.stat().st_size,'dimensions':dimensions})
    (OUT/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'report_id':rid,'screenshots':manifest},indent=2)+'\\n')
    print(json.dumps({'output':str(OUT),'screenshots':len(shots),'manifest':str(OUT/'manifest.json'),'hashes':manifest},indent=2))
    browser.close()
PY"
